hero_tagline: Giving here is an act of worship, not a transaction — a tangible way of trusting God as our provider. Every gift, however large or small, makes a real difference in Charlottesville and beyond.
mail_para: Prefer to give by check? You may mail your tithes and offerings directly to us at the address below. Please make checks payable to Church Of The Living God.
option1_desc: Honor God with the firstfruits of your increase. Tithes sustain the ongoing work and daily ministry of the church.
option2_desc: Beyond the tithe, offerings are a joyful expression of gratitude that support special needs and ministry initiatives.
option3_desc: Help us maintain and grow our physical home in Charlottesville, creating a welcoming space for worship and community for years to come.
option4_desc: Partner with us in reaching the lost and caring for the hurting, both locally and around the world, through missions giving.
